sources.relationship: Operator details referenced normatively by ISO 32000-2 Annex B; external primary reference, not a nineteenth retained PDF.

scope: Frozen typed grammar and source work budget; braces only as conditional bodies, at most255 levels.
Conservative straight-line type/stack checks; data-dependent branch/copy/index/roll shapes are deferred, never rejected merely because intermediate shapes differ.
Explicit evaluation with per-invocation stack/work/depth bounds, typed operands, Domain input clipping and Range output clipping, exactly n numeric finite results.
No file, network, PostScript interpreter, renderer or global registry in production.

boundaries: Finite examples do not prove function validity over its entire Domain. Runtime exceptions remain explicit for input-dependent errors.

Integer word size follows the PHP build; 64-bit operation is tested. Real arithmetic uses finite PHP binary64, with explicit overflow/domain failures; this is not a bit-identical emulation of every PDF processor.

Ghostscript signed right shifts of negative integers differ from the zero-fill rule of PLRM p539. Positive shifts are cross-checked by the independent engine; negative64-bit shifts are checked directly against the normative bit rule.
Generic imported or pre-encoded FunctionType4 streams are not parsed by this typed constructor. External PDF import belongs to an explicit Reader bridge.
